Claude Code 2.1.280 · ~/.claude.json

projects[<project path>]

  • object
  • 8 keys always, up to 35 in the sample
  • 72 entries

One project's state: its trust decision, its local MCP servers and their toggles, whether its CLAUDE.md may import files from outside it, a few prompt-box and tip caches, and a snapshot of the last session's cost and latency. The eight keys of the default project object appear in every entry because any write copies them in; the rest appear once the feature that writes them has run.

Most of this entry is bookkeeping. Three keys change behaviour: hasTrustDialogAccepted, mcpServers, and hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved. The last* block looks like a resume cache and is not one: 2.1.280 writes it at the end of an interactive session and reads it only to send one analytics event at the next startup.

Trust and consent3 keys

KeyTypeWhat it holds
hasTrustDialogAcceptedboolin 72 of 72 (true in 62)You accepted the workspace trust dialog for this key. false is the default copied into every new entry and means never accepted, not declined: declining exits without writing. Checked two ways, described on the projects page. docs
hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApprovedboolin 72 of 72You approved @path imports in CLAUDE.md (and symlinked rules) that resolve outside the project. The memory loader includes those files only when this is true. binary
hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesWarningShownboolin 72 of 72The external-imports dialog was answered here, so it is not shown again whatever the answer. binary

MCP servers and toggles5 keys

KeyTypeWhat it holds
mcpServers/object · mapin 18 of 72 (non-empty in 1)Local-scope MCP servers: yours, for this project only. docs open →
disabledMcpServersarray of stringin 1 of 72Servers switched off in /mcp for this project: configured servers of any scope, plugin servers, claude.ai connectors (by display name) and built-ins that default to on. docs
enabledMcpjsonServersarray of stringin 72 of 72 (all empty)Legacy home of the approved .mcp.json servers. Approvals now live in .claude/settings.local.json; a startup step moves a non-empty list there and deletes it, so only the empty default survives. binary
disabledMcpjsonServersarray of stringin 72 of 72 (all empty)Legacy home of the rejected .mcp.json servers; moved the same way. binary
mcpContextUrisarrayin 72 of 72 (all empty)Vestigial: seeded as [] by the project defaults and never read or written again in 2.1.280. binary

Prompt box and tips3 keys

KeyTypeWhat it holds
exampleFilesarray of stringin 16 of 72Five file names this repository changes most (from git log, filtered to your commits when there are enough), used in the empty prompt's placeholder: Try "how does <file> work?". Regenerated after 7 days. binary
exampleFilesGeneratedAtintin 14 of 72When exampleFiles was generated, epoch ms. binary
hasUnseenTeamArtifactsboolin 24 of 72A teammate added a project skill or command in the last 7 days that you have not been shown; drives the "New from your team" tip. Needs trust, since it runs git log. binary

The last session, for one analytics event19 keys

Read by nothing but the next startup in the same project, which sends it once in the tengu_exit analytics event. Not used by /cost or by --resume, which restores cost from the transcript. Each write replaces the previous values. The sampled entries lack lastStartTime, which 2.1.280 always writes, so they were last written by earlier releases.

KeyTypeWhat it holds
lastSessionIdstringin 11 of 72Session id (UUID) of the session these stats describe. binary
lastCostfloatin 11 of 72Estimated cost of the session in US dollars, including cost restored on resume. binary
lastDurationintin 11 of 72Wall-clock length of the session, ms. binary
lastAPIDurationintin 11 of 72Summed API request time including retries, ms. binary
lastAPIDurationWithoutRetriesintin 11 of 72Summed API request time counting only each request's final attempt, ms. binary
lastToolDurationintin 11 of 72Summed tool execution time, ms. binary
lastLinesAddedintin 11 of 72Lines added by file edits. binary
lastLinesRemovedintin 11 of 72Lines removed by file edits. binary
lastTotalInputTokensintin 11 of 72Uncached input tokens over all models. binary
lastTotalOutputTokensintin 11 of 72Output tokens over all models, thinking included. binary
lastTotalCacheCreationInputTokensintin 11 of 72Prompt-cache write tokens over all models. binary
lastTotalCacheReadInputTokensintin 11 of 72Prompt-cache read tokens over all models. binary
lastTotalWebSearchRequestsintin 11 of 72Server-side web searches. binary
lastModelUsage/object · mapin 11 of 72Tokens and estimated cost of the last session, per model. binary open →
lastFpsAveragefloatin 9 of 72Average terminal frame rate of the session, frames per second. binary
lastFpsLow1Pctfloatin 9 of 72The "1% low" frame rate: 1000 over the slowest 1% frame time, fps. binary
lastSessionMetrics/objectin 8 of 72Latency histograms of the last interactive session: UI frames, hook runs, PreToolUse hooks. binary open →
lastGracefulShutdownboolin 6 of 72Crash marker: set false when an interactive session mounts and true by a clean exit, so a false at the next start means the last session died. binary
lastVersionBasestringin 6 of 72Claude Code version of that session, as major.minor.patch. binary

Legacy keys no installed release reads5 keys

Keys that 2.1.280, 2.1.260, 2.1.195, 2.1.183 and 2.1.281 on this machine never mention. Saves keep unknown keys, so they stay until the entry is purged.

KeyTypeWhat it holds
allowedToolsarrayin 72 of 72 (all empty)Old per-project list of pre-approved tools. Seeded as [] by the defaults; no 2.1.280 permission code reads it. Approvals you give in a session go to .claude/settings.local.json. docs
lastHintSessionIdstringin 2 of 72Unknown. Probably the session a resume hint was last shown for. No installed build references the key. inferred
lastSessionFirstPromptstringin 2 of 72Unknown to 2.1.280. The name says it holds the first prompt of the last session, which would be user content in plain text. No installed build references the key; an older release wrote it and nothing removes it. inferred
lastSessionModifiedintin 2 of 72Unknown. By its magnitude an epoch-ms timestamp of the last session. No installed build references the key. inferred
reactVulnerabilityCache/objectin 7 of 72Legacy. A cached per-project dependency-scan result that no installed Claude Code reads. inferred open →

Keys 2.1.280 can write that this sample lacks19 keys

Written only when the feature behind them runs, so a given file may never hold them.

Key names, types and presence counts were measured on one real ~/.claude.json (82 top-level keys, 72 project entries) on 28 September 2026; no value from that file is published here, and keys that are data (paths, UUIDs, names) are replaced by placeholders. Meanings are read from the Claude Code 2.1.280 binary binary, from Anthropic's documentation docs, or inferred from names and nearby code inferred. Undocumented keys can change in any release.
